name: ERCF v2
description: The Enraged Rabbit Carrot Feeder v2 is an expandable multi-material unit for Klipper-based 3D printers. It uses a Type-A selector design where a single shared gear stepper drives filament while a separate selector stepper moves a linear carriage to align with the desired filament gate. A servo engages and disengages the gear mechanism for the selected gate, and an encoder near the gear motor tracks filament movement for validation. Recommended gate configurations are 4, 8, or 12, though the design supports custom gate counts.
features: Sturdy backbone design with no flex
Reliable custom encoder for filament tracking
Innovative filament trap in blocks instead of magnetic gates
Sprung servo instead of adjustable top hats
Optional ERCT buffer with pre-gate sensors and NeoPixel LEDs
